goal: Learn Java concurrency by building a real-time recommendation engine, so I can build systems like MiniTrino on my own

environment_notes.build_tool: Maven 3.9, one module per phase, challenge folders hold READMEs, tests run with -Dtest='CNN*' from the challenge folder via the phase pom
environment_notes.scope: Phases 1-12 are generated (Phase 1 and 5 first, then 2-4 and 6-12). Phase 13 (Kafka and Redis) is gated behind the main roadmap's Kafka phase and not generated.
